newsitem.title: CHINA: Trading in Wing Fai shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: Trading in Wing Fai shares suspended.

text.p: Trading in shares of civil engineering concern Wing Fai International Ltd was suspended at the company's request pending an announcement, the Hong Kong stock exchange said on Friday.
Wing Fai shares rose HK$0.13 or 18.57 percent to end Thursday at HK$0.83. Volume was 56.89 million shares.

The company repairs and maintains civil engineering establishments and buildings in the public sector, including Hong Kong International Airport, and installs utilities including telephone facilities.
